speaker: Flo
text: Many shops have incentives to use mobile payment services because this way they can engage customers better. After I paid for a sandwich and a cup of coffee at a restaurant with my smartphone, the waitress asked me to “follow” their public account so they could send me coupons and a virtual membership card. On the door of a nearby fashion boutique, there was another sign: “Welcome to use mobile payment!”
